aimpreview.config.title: AimPreview
aimpreview.config.spread.desc: Vanilla adds a little random spread to every shot, so it can land a bit off the line. This outlines the area where it can land.
aimpreview.config.spreadScale.desc: How much of the largest possible spread the area covers. 1.0 covers every possible landing point; smaller values show where most shots land.
aimpreview.config.spreadColor.desc: Fill color of the spread area. Its outline uses the same color without transparency.
aimpreview.config.enabled.desc: Turns the mod on or off. The toggle key (unbound by default, set it in Controls) switches this too.
aimpreview.config.timing.desc: While aiming: bow and trident while drawn, crossbow while loaded, thrown items while held. While holding: whenever a supported item is in hand; an undrawn bow shows the fully drawn path.
aimpreview.config.throughWalls.desc: Draws the path and markers on top of blocks instead of hiding the parts behind them.
aimpreview.config.hideWithHud.desc: Hides everything while the HUD is hidden (F1).
aimpreview.config.maxTicks.desc: How far ahead the flight is simulated. 20 ticks is one second of flight.
aimpreview.config.startDistance.desc: Leaves out the part of the path this close to your eyes, so it does not start in your face.
aimpreview.config.steadyLine.desc: With View Bobbing on, walking sways the whole view, and your aim line with it. This keeps the line in front of you steady with the crosshair; the far end still sits on the ground it lands on.
aimpreview.config.lineStyle.desc: Solid line, dashed line, or a row of small cubes.
aimpreview.config.lineWidth.desc: Thickness of the lines and outlines.
aimpreview.config.lineColor.desc: Color of your own aim path.
aimpreview.config.colorOnHit.desc: Uses the hit color while the path runs into an entity.
aimpreview.config.hitColor.desc: Line color while the path runs into an entity.
aimpreview.config.dashLength.desc: Length of each dash and gap of the dashed line, in blocks.
aimpreview.config.cubeSize.desc: Size of each cube of the cube line, in blocks.
aimpreview.config.cubeSpacing.desc: Distance between the cubes, in blocks.
aimpreview.config.marker.desc: Marks the spot where the projectile lands.
aimpreview.config.markerColor.desc: Fill color of the landing marker. Its outline uses the same color without transparency.
aimpreview.config.markerSize.desc: Width of the landing marker, in blocks.
aimpreview.config.highlight.desc: Draws a box around the entity the projectile would hit.
aimpreview.config.highlightColor.desc: Color of the box around the target.
aimpreview.config.sound.desc: Plays a sound once when your aim comes onto an entity.
aimpreview.config.distanceHud.desc: Shows how far away the landing point is, next to the crosshair.
aimpreview.config.hudOffsetX.desc: Position of the distance text from the crosshair, to the right.
aimpreview.config.hudOffsetY.desc: Position of the distance text from the crosshair, downwards.
aimpreview.config.hudShadow.desc: Draws the distance text with a shadow.
aimpreview.config.flyingMode.desc: Draws where arrows, tridents and thrown items already in the air will go.
aimpreview.config.flyingMaxCount.desc: At most this many paths are drawn, nearest first.
aimpreview.config.flyingRange.desc: Only projectiles within this many blocks are drawn.
aimpreview.config.flyingColor.desc: Line color of projectiles in flight.
aimpreview.config.flyingMarker.desc: Marks where projectiles in flight will land.
aimpreview.config.flyingHighlight.desc: Draws a box around the entity a projectile in flight will hit.
aimpreview.config.bow.desc: Shows the path of arrows shot from a bow.
aimpreview.config.crossbow.desc: Shows the path of arrows shot from a crossbow.
aimpreview.config.crossbowFirework.desc: Shows the path of fireworks shot from a crossbow, up to where they explode.
aimpreview.config.multishotAll.desc: Shows all three paths of a Multishot crossbow. Off shows only the middle one.
aimpreview.config.trident.desc: Shows the path of a thrown trident (not with Riptide).
aimpreview.config.enderPearl.desc: Shows the path of ender pearls.
aimpreview.config.splashPotion.desc: Shows the path of splash potions.
aimpreview.config.lingeringPotion.desc: Shows the path of lingering potions.
aimpreview.config.experienceBottle.desc: Shows the path of bottles o' enchanting.
aimpreview.config.windCharge.desc: Shows the path of wind charges.
aimpreview.config.fishingRod.desc: Shows where the bobber lands when you cast.
